## About
Best Roofing Specialists is a roofing contractor on Topanga Canyon Blvd in Woodland Hills. We repair storm damage, replace roofs, install gutters, and work on skylights and sections of a home that need something other than standard shingles.
Customers tend to mention Miguel and Billy by name. Miguel walks the roof, points out what needs attention, and lays out the options. Billy leads the crew on site and stops to answer questions as the work goes.
We try to leave a house looking like we were barely there, apart from the new roof. That means checking the yard for nails and debris and making sure you know who to call if anything comes up later.

## Services
- Roof repairs: We look over the roof, explain what is damaged, and repair it.
- Full roof replacement: A complete new roof when repairs aren't enough.
- Gutter installation: New gutters installed along with your roof work.
- Skylight replacement: We can help you decide whether to keep and upgrade skylights during a reroof.
- TPO roofing: Shingles on the main house and TPO roofing on an addition, when that is the better fit.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with an insurance claim?
A: Yes. One reviewer said Miguel helped with the insurance claim process, and another said Billy lifted roof panels so the adjuster could see the storm damage clearly.
